ko: [Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=1)]순금이 이렇게나 많은데, 누가 뺏으러 오지 않을까요?
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]정말 누가 오기라도 한다면, 내가 쓰러뜨리면 되지.
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]응! 나도 모든 적을 이 뿔로 쓰러뜨릴 수 있어!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]에스텔 언니는 뿔로 모든 적을 쓰러뜨린대요!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]우와, 에스텔 언니, 예전이랑 전혀 다르네요.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]그래서 말인데, 우리 함께 고향에 가서 보물 찾지 않을래요?
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]이를테면, 이 순금을 제조소에서 창고로 옮긴다든지.
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]설마 정말 우리 순금을 노리는 녀석들이 있나?
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]하앗! 안 돼, 가까이 오지 마! 야압!!
en: [Title] MAIN_LOG_104_1
[Div] Part.03
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=1)]You think anyone'll try to steal all this pure gold from us?
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Who'd have the guts? I'll knock 'em flat.
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]Mm-hm! I can knock anyone flat too!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]No one's taking anything from us right now!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]With those horns, Estelle, you're knocking EVERYONE down!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]But wow, you're acting a little different from before.
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]Um, really?
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Really!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]So, how about we head back home together, and hunt for the treasure?
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]You mean right now?
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Do we even know it's real?
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Besides, we've got other things to do, right this moment.
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Like, for example, lugging all this pure gold from the factory to the depot.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Hneugh!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1.5)]Who is it... who's in front of us...?
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]Wait! Did someone come to steal our gold?
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]Haugh! I won't let you anywhere near! Yah!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Wait, Estelle!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Gavial, hold her down, quick!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Oh no, Gavial got sent flying!
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_104_1
[Div] Part.03
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=1)]こんなたくさんの純金、誰かに奪われたりしないでしょうか？
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]マジで奪いに来るようなヤツがいるか？　いたらアタシがぶちのめしてやるよ。
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]うん！　敵は全員倒す！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]私たちから奪えるような人はいないよ！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]エステルさんは角で突き倒せますもんね！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]いや〜エステルさん、前とちょっと雰囲気変わりましたね。
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]えっ、ほんとに？
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]ほんとですよ！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]ですから、私と一緒に故郷に帰って宝探ししませんか？
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]今から？
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]マジで宝なんかがあるわけねぇだろ？
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]それよりも、今はやらなきゃなんねぇことがあんだろうが。
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]たとえば、この純金を乗せた台車を製造所から倉庫に運ぶとかよ。
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]よいしょ！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1.5)]あそこにいるのは……誰だろう……？
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]本当に誰かが私たちの純金を奪いに来たのかも？
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]はっ！　誰も近づかせないんだからね！　やあーっ！！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]待ってください、エステルさん！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]ガヴィルさん、早く止めてください！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]ガヴィルさんが吹き飛ばされちゃった！！
